body.purpose: Default for rows, buttons, tabs, inputs.

data.purpose: Machine text: raw errors, activity log, durations, shortcuts.

shadows.name: shadow-float-dark
shadows.purpose: Floating layers only: sheets, menus, palette, tooltips.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Standard bordered action and all recovery actions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: fg-bordered, one per sheet footer; never amber.

components.name: Count
components.description: Plain tabular count; amber when dead-letter above zero.

components.name: Problem
components.description: The one error form: amber icon + title, sentence, mono detail, action.

components.name: Toggle Group
components.description: Independent on/off items in one 24px frame; on = selection fill + check. Multi-select only; one-of-many uses Segmented.

components.name: Body Line
components.description: Body viewer line: faint line number in a side-coloured gutter with a 1px rule, fg mono 11/16 text, no syntax colours.

narrative.overview: The data is the interface. Graphite or paper-white in three close surface tiers, 1px lines, square panels, 3px controls, 12px OS UI text with JetBrains Mono for data. One amber accent, only on dead-letter counts above zero, PROD, and errors.
keyCharacteristics: Amber always with icon or text
Dark and light follow the OS; offline fonts

rules.name: The Earned Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only on dead-letter count above zero, PROD, error icon+title, invalid-field border, connection-trouble alert mark. Never on a button.

rules.name: The Two-Channel Rule
rules.body: Amber always travels with a second carrier: the PROD word, a CircleAlert icon with text, or a number.

rules.name: The Neutral Interaction Rule
rules.body: Hover, active, selected, focused and primary resolve to neutral roles.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Mono marks machine output; names and prose stay in the UI face.

dos: Do use amber only per the Earned Amber Rule, always with icon or text.
Do keep selection, hover, focus and primary neutral.
Do use Problem for every error.
Do confirm destructive actions in context, never in a modal.
donts: Don't put amber on a button, tab, selection or link.
Don't add cards, gradients, glows, pills or illustrations.
Don't add radii above 3px or shadows on anything at rest.
Don't use modal dialogs for confirmation or forms.
